categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Jingyuan Environmental Protection Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the industrial water treatment sector, providing integrated services including design, manufacturing, sales, engineering contracting, and operation of environmental water treatment equipment. The company also engages in intelligent operation and maintenance services, cloud computing, and AI-enabled environmental solutions. It serves industries such as power generation, steel, chemical, municipal, and metal products, with a growing presence in overseas markets like Southeast Asia.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed core technologies including industrial wastewater electronic coagulation, intelligent superconducting magnetic medium coagulation and sedimentation, high-difficulty wastewater zero discharge, and high-difficulty wastewater electrochemical oxidation. It employs advanced manufacturing methods such as modular equipment design, intelligent production lines, and integrates AI and IoT for smart dosing and operation. The production model is mainly customized, with core components self-produced and assembled, supported by external suppliers for non-core parts.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large industrial enterprises primarily in the power generation sector, including major state-owned power groups, as well as steel, chemical, municipal, and metal product industries. The company also serves emerging markets in cloud computing and AI-enabled environmental services. Its products and services are used in industrial wastewater treatment, water reuse, and zero discharge projects, with a focus on high-end and complex water treatment needs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with significant business in regions such as Northwest, East China, North China, Central China, South China, and Southwest China. It has expanded internationally with subsidiaries and projects in Southeast Asia, notably Indonesia and Thailand, under its 'ReClear' brand, targeting the Belt and Road Initiative markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Jingyuan Environmental Protection operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the water treatment supply chain. It designs, manufactures, and integrates water treatment equipment and systems, provides engineering contracting and consulting services, and manages operation and maintenance of water treatment infrastructure, thus covering the full lifecycle of water treatment solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth, focusing on advancing core water treatment technologies and integrating AI and cloud computing to enhance smart operation and management. It invests in R&D for new products like AI dosing machines and modular equipment, collaborates with top research institutions, and pursues international expansion. Strategic priorities include improving efficiency, expanding into non-power industries, and developing intelligent, green, and digital water treatment solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through sales of customized industrial water treatment equipment and systems, engineering contracting services (EPC), design and consulting services, and infrastructure investment and operation. The company also earns income from intelligent operation and maintenance services and cloud computing services. Sales are primarily secured through bidding and contracts with large industrial clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a strong competitive position in the power industry water treatment market, with recognized advanced technologies and a growing market share estimated between 3% to 6% in the power sector. It faces competition in a fragmented industry with many players but differentiates itself through proprietary technologies, integrated services, and expanding into emerging markets and AI-enabled environmental solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 476 million, a 20.18% increase year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 24.73 million, showing a reduction in losses compared to prior years. Total assets were about RMB 1.84 billion, with equity attributable to shareholders around RMB 780 million. The company has a stable growth trajectory supported by increased market expansion and improved operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Jingyuan Environmental Protection offers high-efficiency, low-cost, and environmentally friendly water treatment solutions with advanced proprietary technologies such as electronic coagulation and superconducting magnetic medium coagulation. Its products feature automation, modular design, and AI integration, providing customers with intelligent, comprehensive lifecycle services. The company emphasizes innovation, customization, and smart operation to deliver superior environmental performance and operational cost savings.
